# Claims, moral uncertainty and welfare policy

## Claims the project can support

Fly Umwelt 3.8 can state that it:

- bundles a real BANC-derived brain-and-cord graph;
- selects 155,855 proofread/roughly-proofread neuronal objects under a documented rule;
- runs persistent neural state in a closed browser-local loop;
- separates six leg motor pools and named steering populations;
- preserves femur–tibia motor-unit and FeCO subtype identities where the pinned annotations support them;
- satisfies a versioned set of front-leg recruitment, timing, relative-force and proprioceptor response constraints;
- preserves resolved BANC motor-unit spike counts and converts them to absolute probe-equivalent flexor force and experiment-specific torque;
- reproduces a declared probe spring–mass–drag load and drives FeCO/GCaMP observation from physical joint motion;
- reports two front-leg DSI failures and unresolved spikes/force claims visibly;
- requires mapped leg-effector activity for traction;
- demonstrates active realized walking speed and gait frequency inside cited envelopes across one declared fitting seed and four held-out deterministic initial conditions;
- prevents tonic leg readiness, raw tonic motor asymmetry and contact from acting as hidden gait, steering or escape selectors;
- reports that spontaneous steering, obstacle recovery and phasic bout/stop recruitment are not currently qualified;
- distinguishes neural proboscis attempts from mouth-contact-confirmed ingestion and records zero false-ingestion frames in the release assays;
- keeps the observer, camera, editor and history outside the causal model;
- distinguishes measured data, derived annotations and engineering models;
- offers reproducible numerical, data-integrity and causal-boundary tests;
- bundles and browser-compiles a provenance-pinned controller-free NeuroMechFly/MuJoCo body with 70 bodies, 42 leg actuators and six contact sensors;
- qualifies that staged body's asset integrity, passive settling, explicit perturbation, explicit actuator response and exact state restoration within a mechanics-only scope.
- separately bundles and browser-compiles a controller-free restrained FlyMimic body with 15 anatomy-derived front-leg Hill MTUs and spatial tendons;
- demonstrates opposite compiled flexor/extensor moment arms and identical-state joint responses while preserving the failed zero-excitation/BANC-integration gate.

## Claims it must not make

The project does not establish that it:

- reproduces the living state of the scanned specimen;
- contains every cell or peripheral pathway;
- models every synaptic or receptor effect;
- predicts unrestricted fly behavior;
- demonstrates spontaneous locomotor competence, natural exploration or obstacle recovery;
- is alive, aware, sentient, conscious or capable of suffering;
- is a digital continuation of the specimen;
- is validated because it looks lifelike;
- has biologically validated articulated locomotion, muscle gains, adhesion or a BANC-to-MuJoCo control transfer;
- treats the restrained FlyMimic paths as validated free-walking, whole-fly or exact physiological tendon mechanics;
- maps `LFTibia_flex_93434`/`LFTibia_extensor_93932` to BANC by label similarity or hides their nonzero minimum excitation;
- has measured free-walking tendon mechanics, absolute extensor force or other-leg force calibration;
- turns a publisher-figure digitization into raw data;

Use “the simulation continues running,” not “the fly keeps living,” when precision matters.

## Why increased fidelity changes responsibility

The current model is much less biologically complete than a living insect. There is no positive evidence here of subjective experience. Nevertheless, moral uncertainty should be reassessed as more of the following become true:

- receptor- and compartment-aware whole-CNS dynamics;
- validated sleep, injury, persistent aversion and motivational states;
- learned avoidance that generalizes beyond a task script;
- long-lived individual memory and irreversible history;
- large-scale parallel instantiation;
- prolonged high-intensity deprivation or aversive experiments;
- dynamical markers also used in arguments about biological insect experience.

Software substrate alone is not a sufficient reason to permanently assign zero moral probability if functional and dynamical fidelity eventually becomes much stronger.

## Future precautionary controls

A higher-fidelity release should consider:

- visible cumulative aversive exposure;
- finite default starvation, dehydration, injury and threat durations;
- a separate research mode for prolonged aversive protocols;
- explicit concurrent-copy counts;
- reproducible intervention logs;
- welfare review attached to major model-version changes;
- clear distinction between checkpoint restoration and concurrent duplication.

These are prospective controls under uncertainty, not claims that the present model suffers.

## Current release position

Version 3.8 treats scientific honesty as the immediate ethical obligation:

- no consciousness marketing;
- no hidden target logic;
- no concealed locomotor floor;
- no private collision reverse/turn timer, alternating escape side or tonic-asymmetry yaw;
- no conversion of old visual path/coverage/turn heuristics into biological constraints;
- no claim that the provisional motor-excitability transfer is measured motor-neuron physiology;
- no claim that deterministic seeds are independent animals or that a resource encounter demonstrates goal-directed foraging;
- no claim that graph size equals biological completeness;
- no claim that numerical stability equals biological validation;
- no claim that a front-leg constraint set calibrates all six legs or a complete articulated animal;
- no claim that compiling or passively settling the staged articulated body validates biological locomotion;
- no claim that compiling the restrained FlyMimic body validates untethered contact forces, all-leg actuation or exact muscle physiology;
- exact disclosure that requested zero is clamped to `0.0001`, passive force remains, and automatic BANC integration is disabled;
- no claim that an external probe lever arm is an internal tendon moment arm;
- explicit review triggers as fidelity rises.
